headline: The documented 2.5% Gold and 5x/1x EcoCard rates with round-down rounding give exactly the four gold disputes; the only gap is the rounding doc missing from the required list.

issues.summary: The floor-rounding rule that makes the gold dispute set exact (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007) is not in this task's required_documents, so the golden_retrieval variant never shows it.
evidence: task_019.required_documents does not include doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 (grep: only task_028 lists it)
src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/retrieval.py build_tools: "# No retrieval tools (no_knowledge, full_kb, golden_retrieval)"

doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: Under golden_retrieval the agent cannot search the KB, so it must guess the rounding convention; round-half-up flags 11 extra transactions (e.g. txn_f2a3b4c5d6e7 Sprouts 112.58x5=562.9 -> 563 vs stored 562). Search-based configs (default alltools, bm25, etc.) can retrieve doc_007, so headline scores are unaffected.

solution_check: Computed all 23 transactions for af0581dcbf: Gold Rewards 2.5% on everything (doc_..._gold_rewards_card_001 "Cash back on all purchases: 2.5%"), EcoCard 5/$ on Green, 1/$ otherwise. Under floor the only mismatches are the gold four: f093f9 (Thrive Market Green 175x5=875 vs 175), 580773 (Uber 240x2.5=600 vs 240), d39854 (Tentree Green 200x5=1000 vs 600), 37b5b8 (Nordstrom 320x2.5=800 vs 775). Round-half-up adds 11 false positives.
prior_note: Prior (Major) said the rounding convention was undocumented; doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007 states floor rounding, is unchanged since v1.0.0, and reproduces the gold exactly, so that defect never applied to search-based configs. Only the required_documents omission remains.
notes: Required doc doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001 changed in v1.0.1 only cosmetically ("$105 days" -> "105 days"); it still carries the corrupted "Minimum credit score required: $720", which is irrelevant here. Thrive Market is an online marketplace, and doc_..._ecocard_003 says marketplace purchases "may not qualify"; the row's category is Green and ecocard_004's exclusion list names only Target/Walmart/Amazon/ThredUp, so 5x is the better-supported reading (and Thrive Market earns 5x in task_022's seed data).
